country: Pays d'outre-mer de la Polynésie française

fields.terrain: mixture of rugged high islands and low islands with reefs
fields.farm: coconuts, fruits, cassava, sugarcane, pineapples, eggs, tropical fruits, watermelons, tomatoes, pork
fields.exports: pearls, fish, aircraft parts, gas turbines, vanilla
fields.industries: tourism, pearls, agricultural processing, handicrafts, phosphates
fields.languages: French (official) 73.5%, Tahitian 20.1%, Marquesan 2.6%, Austral languages 1.2%, Paumotu 1%, other 1.6%
fields.religions: Protestant 54%, Roman Catholic 30%, other 10%, no religion 6%

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Assembly of French Polynesia); an overseas collectivity of France
